# ProjectIcon

<!-- description:start -->
Displays a colored icon for a Tracker project entity. The icon color is deterministically derived from the `projectId`, so the same project always renders the same color across sessions and environments.
<!-- description:end -->

## Usage

```tsx
import {ProjectIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<ProjectIcon projectId={123} />
```

## Component props

<!-- props:start -->
```ts
{
    /**
     * Project ID used to generate a deterministic color.
     * Accepts either the numeric shortId or a string entity ID.
     */
    projectId?: number | string;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the root element.
     */
    className?: string;

    /**
     * Entity type label. Defaults to "project".
     */
    type?: string;

    /**
     * Size of the SVG icon inside the container in pixels.
     * @default 16
     */
    size?: number;

    /**
     * Size of the icon container (the colored square) in pixels.
     * @default 24
     */
    refugeSize?: number;

    /**
     * Whether to render a colored background behind the icon.
     * @default true
     */
    withBackground?: boolean;

    /**
     * Border radius variant of the icon container.
     * @default 'm'
     */
    radius?: 'm' | 'l';

    /**
     * Alpha (opacity) of the icon foreground color.
     * @default 1
     */
    colorAlpha?: number;
}
```
<!-- props:end -->

---

## Examples

### Default

```tsx
import {ProjectIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<ProjectIcon projectId={123} />
```

### Without background

```tsx
// Renders only the colored SVG, no background square
<ProjectIcon projectId={123} withBackground={false} />
```

### Custom size

```tsx
<ProjectIcon projectId={123} size={20} refugeSize={32} />
```

### Large radius

```tsx
<ProjectIcon projectId={123} radius="l" />
```

### Alongside project name

```tsx
import {ProjectIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

export const ProjectLabel = ({project}: {project: {shortId: number; name: string}}) => (
    <div style={{display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8}}>
        <ProjectIcon projectId={project.shortId} />
        <span>{project.name}</span>
    </div>
);
```

### Multiple projects (each gets a unique color)

```tsx
const projects = [
    {shortId: 1, name: 'Backend API'},
    {shortId: 2, name: 'Mobile App'},
    {shortId: 3, name: 'Design System'},
];

projects.map((p) => (
    <div key={p.shortId} style={{display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8}}>
        <ProjectIcon projectId={p.shortId} />
        <span>{p.name}</span>
    </div>
));
```

### Rendering from a Tracker API response

The Tracker entities search endpoint returns `shortId` as a number — pass it directly:

```tsx
import React, {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
import {ProjectIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';
import type {MetaEntityV2} from '@weavix/tracker-api-types';

interface Props {
    trackerApi: TrackerApi;
}

export const ProjectList: React.FC<Props> = ({trackerApi}) => {
    const [projects, setProjects] = useState<MetaEntityV2[]>([]);

    useEffect(() => {
        trackerApi.v3
            .post['/entities/{entityType}/_search']({
                pathParams: {entityType: 'project'},
                queryParams: {fields: ['summary'], page: 1, perPage: 20},
                bodyParams: {filter: {}, filterTypes: ['ALL'], input: ''},
            })
            .then((result) => setProjects(result.data));
    }, [trackerApi]);

    return (
        <ul>
            {projects.map((project) => (
                <li key={project.id} style={{display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8}}>
                    <ProjectIcon projectId={project.shortId} />
                    <span>{project.fields?.summary?.value ?? project.id}</span>
                </li>
            ))}
        </ul>
    );
};
```

---

## Notes

- `withBackground` defaults to `true` for projects (vs `false` for [`PortfolioIcon`](../PortfolioIcon/README.md)).
- Pass `projectId` as the **numeric `shortId`** from the Tracker API for consistent color generation. String IDs are also accepted.
- To render the correct icon for an arbitrary meta entity type, use [`MetaEntityIcon`](../MetaEntityIcon/README.md) instead.
